verdict.rationale: Alloy publishes an llms.txt index at developer.alloy.com/public/llms.txt that lists its doc pages, and serves docs as raw .md files an agent can fetch, so agent-oriented docs exist. However, the probe of the conventional root path /llms.txt returned 404, so an agent following the standard convention would not find it, and no first-party docs describe or promote agent use. missing for 10: llms.txt at the standard root path, documentation explaining agent-oriented doc access (e.g. llms-full.txt or usage guidance), independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming the docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
